verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents a dedicated startups/entrepreneurs practice whose attorneys wrote a founder immigration guide, plus an O-1 practice page, which implies the firm handles visa petitions for founders. The evidence never describes end-to-end petition preparation as the core service. The Visalaw AI drafting and exhibit-list features are software sold to immigration teams, not a service delivered to the founder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, expert and support letter drafting, form preparation, filing handled by the firm, and any independent corroboration.
